# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 14 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Market

- **Hong Leong-TID JV awarded Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA has awarded the Orchard Boulevard Government Land Sale site to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential for S$181.86 million, or approximately S$1,755 psf ppr. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

- **Foreign groups in deals worth up to S$11 billion for Singapore landmark buildings** - Hongkong Land and IOI are buying up Singapore's marquee commercial assets in transactions that could total around S$11 billion. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-marquee-assets-having-moment-year/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **November BTO draws over 35,600 applications, two-room flats hit record** - The November BTO exercise attracted more than 35,600 applications — the highest rate since 2022 — with two-room flats recording a record number of applicants. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-bto-draws-35600-applications-two/)

- **Yishun executive flat sells for S$1,328,888, a new area record** - A 1,765 sqft executive flat at Yishun Avenue 4 changed hands for S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming Yishun's most expensive HDB resale across all flat types and the first in the area to cross S$1.3 million. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

- **February 2027 BTO launch to offer about 4,300 flats across four towns** - HDB's upcoming February 2027 BTO exercise will cover Bishan, Toa Payoh, Tampines and Tengah, with a breakdown of expected prices and demand reviewed for each site. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/review-february-2027-bto-launch-sites/)

## Urban Transformation

- **Toa Payoh West master plan to bring 6,000-plus new homes and amenities around Caldecott MRT** - HDB's plan for Toa Payoh West includes more than 6,000 new homes alongside a shopping mall, parks and community facilities, with changes expected to unfold over the next decade. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/toa-payoh-west-transformation/)
